passages.text: Dicliptera is a genus of flowering plants in the bear's breeches family, Acanthaceae. It includes 223 species native to the tropics and subtropics worldwide. Well-known synonyms include Peristrophe and Dactylostegium.

Host plant 
Dicliptera{{which|reason=do all species host this butterfly or just some?|date=November 2024}} functions as a host plant for the butterfly, Anartia fatima.
